import json, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
import verify as V
from protocol import validate, loads

def run(req, verify=True):
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','submission/main.py'],input=json.dumps(req,separators=(',',':')).encode(),capture_output=True)
    assert p.returncode==0, p.stderr.decode()[:3000]
    out=p.stdout.decode()
    if verify:
        V.verify(req, loads(out), validate)
    return json.loads(out)['cases'][0]['events']

# 1. zero commodities, empty worker
c={'nodes':2,'edges':[[0,1,4]],'commodities':[],'workers':[[]],'quorum':1,'max_lag':0,
   'relax':[1,1],'rho':3,'mode':'route','events':[{'op':'issue','id':0,'worker':0},{'op':'deliver','id':0},
   {'op':'step'},{'op':'audit'},{'op':'issue','id':1,'worker':0},{'op':'deliver','id':1},{'op':'step'}]}
out=run({'cases':[c]})
assert out[0]['result']=={'status':'optimal','flow':[],'edge_load':[0.0],'potential':[]}, out[0]
assert out[1]['status']=='accepted'
assert out[2]['status']=='advanced' and out[2]['load']==[0.0] and out[2]['ceiling']==0.0, out[2]
assert out[3]['flow']==[] and out[3]['worker_load']==[[0.0]] and out[3]['age']==[0], out[3]
print('empty worker ok')

# 2. commodity with zero slots and zero demand
c={'nodes':2,'edges':[[0,1,4]],'commodities':[{'source':0,'sink':1,'demand':0,'paths':[]}],
   'workers':[[]],'quorum':1,'max_lag':0,'relax':[1,1],'rho':3,'mode':'route',
   'events':[{'op':'issue','id':0,'worker':0},{'op':'deliver','id':0},{'op':'step'},{'op':'audit'}]}
out=run({'cases':[c]})
assert out[0]['result']['flow']==[] and out[0]['result']['potential']==[], out[0]
print('zero slot ok')

# 3. all edges withdrawn: route infeasible lists everything owned
c={'nodes':3,'edges':[[0,1,0],[1,2,0]],'commodities':[{'source':0,'sink':2,'demand':5,'paths':[None,[0,1]]},
   {'source':0,'sink':1,'demand':0,'paths':[[0]]},{'source':0,'sink':1,'demand':3,'paths':[[0]]}],
   'workers':[[1,2],[0]],'quorum':1,'max_lag':2,'relax':[3,2],'rho':2,'mode':'route',
   'events':[{'op':'issue','id':0,'worker':0},{'op':'issue','id':1,'worker':1},
             {'op':'deliver','id':0},{'op':'deliver','id':1},{'op':'audit'},
             {'op':'configure','mode':'admit','capacity':[[0,7],[1,7]],'demand':[[1,4]],'paths':[]},
             {'op':'issue','id':2,'worker':0},{'op':'issue','id':3,'worker':1},
             {'op':'deliver','id':2},{'op':'deliver','id':3},{'op':'step'},{'op':'step'},{'op':'audit'}]}
out=run({'cases':[c]})
assert out[0]['result']=={'status':'infeasible','unroutable':[2]}, out[0]
assert out[1]['result']['status']=='optimal' and out[1]['result']['flow'][0][0]==0.0, out[1]
assert out[2]['status']=='infeasible' and out[3]['status']=='accepted'
assert out[5]['generation']==1
# admit: commodity2 (3 units over edge0 cap7) and commodity1 demand 4 (no available path? paths None only)
print('withdraw ok', out[6]['result'], out[7]['result'])

# 4. two slots swap transaction legality and null holes preserved
c={'nodes':3,'edges':[[0,1,5],[1,2,5],[0,2,1]],'commodities':[{'source':0,'sink':2,'demand':6,
   'paths':[[0,1],[2]]}],'workers':[[0]],'quorum':1,'max_lag':1,'relax':[5,4],'rho':4,'mode':'route',
   'events':[{'op':'configure','mode':'route','capacity':[],'demand':[],'paths':[[0,0,[2]],[0,1,[0,1]]]},
             {'op':'issue','id':0,'worker':0},{'op':'deliver','id':0},{'op':'audit'},
             {'op':'configure','mode':'route','capacity':[],'demand':[],'paths':[[0,1,None]]},
             {'op':'issue','id':1,'worker':0},{'op':'deliver','id':1},{'op':'audit'},
             {'op':'step'},{'op':'audit'}]}
out=run({'cases':[c]})
assert out[1]['result']['flow'][0][0]==6.0  # slot0 now holds the direct edge path after swap
assert out[3]['flow']==[[6.0,0.0]] or out[3]['flow']==[[6.0,0.0]], out[3]['flow']
assert out[6]['flow']==[[0.0,0.0]] or out[6]['flow']==[[0.0,0.0]], out[6]['flow']
assert out[7]['status']=='advanced', out[7]
print('swap ok')

# 5. big numbers: demand 1000 across 24 commodities on cap 1 edges
coms=[{'source':0,'sink':1,'demand':1000,'paths':[[0]]} for _ in range(24)]

             {'op':'deliver','id':0},{'op':'deliver','id':1},{'op':'deliver','id':2},{'op':'step'},
             {'op':'retune','rho':3},{'op':'audit'},{'op':'issue','id':3,'worker':0},{'op':'deliver','id':3},{'op':'step'},{'op':'audit'}]}
import time
t0=time.time(); out=run({'cases':[c]}); print('big case time',round(time.time()-t0,2))
assert out[6]['status']=='advanced'

print('big case verified')
print('edge cases ok')
